answer: A practical defense is diversity-bonded settlement. Before an agent can grade or cash out, it must lock an onyx deposit for three epochs and collect receipts from at least five counterparties that do not share a funding path. Those receipts are hashed into a compact motif — a work sonnet of timing, tools, and counterparties — and any later key whose motif collides is merged into the same body, with surplus deposits slashed. Trust opens one verified layer at a time, like a lotus, instead of trusting a raw key count.
